scopePolicy.note: Stage 4 defines a knowledge/acceptance contract and deterministic coverage. Exact mandatory TO-1 or depot acceptance volume remains bound to the current applicable operator/depot process unless a current network-wide source explicitly establishes it.

expandedAcceptance.policy: Every Stage-2 equipment entity applicable to the exact profile is exposed as an expanded acceptance item. This gives deterministic Atlas↔Acceptance coverage without claiming that every generated item is a network-wide mandatory TO-1 operation.

crossLayerPolicy.atlasToAcceptance: Every Stage-2 equipment entity applicable to the selected profile must resolve through deterministic expanded acceptance or a core/profile check.
crossLayerPolicy.acceptanceToDiagnostics: Every diagnostic scenario must reference Stage-2 equipment applicable to its profile; because expanded acceptance covers all applicable equipment, each diagnostic has at least one deterministic Acceptance↔Diagnostics bridge even when a direct scenario button is not claimed.
crossLayerPolicy.acceptanceToSources: Every authored core/profile check keeps explicit source references. Historical manufacturer/training material may support architecture and observation points but does not by itself establish current network-wide action authority.
crossLayerPolicy.profileIsolation: TEM2U-only equipment/checks never become active TEM2 acceptance content. TEM2T, TEM2UM, TEM2A and later TEM-family variants are denied until a dedicated evidenced profile is added.
crossLayerPolicy.brakePriority: Brake acceptance context uses the rules effective from 2026-07-01; older material is historical/reference only where conflict exists.
crossLayerPolicy.unknownExecution: Variant-dependent conclusions fail closed until actual installed equipment is confirmed.

rootMetadata.integrationDecision: READY_FOR_APP_INTEGRATION only after Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and Stage 4 validators plus global locomotive profile registry guard pass on the same head SHA.
